text: My daily routine starts early. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and have a quick shower. After that, I eat breakfast and check my emails before I leave for work. I work from nine to five, and I always take a short break at lunchtime. In the afternoon, I go to the gym three times a week because exercise helps me relax. In the evening, I cook dinner and spend time with my family. I go to bed before eleven. I believe consistency is important, so I try to follow the same routine every day.
